body:
Fixes #2687.

Claude's final result reported an account usage limit (`is_error: true`, `api_error: usage_limit_reached`, reset 10:20pm UTC), but Hive Mind replaced it with an earlier Bash exit 127. The wrapper now preserves terminal provider/process errors and their recovery information. A genuinely failed final verification still vetoes an otherwise successful result.

- Share terminal-result handling between normal NDJSON and an unterminated final record, retaining billing cost and rejecting false solution summaries.
- Route account limits ahead of temporary retry flags, and prevent error results from triggering background-task continuation.
- Include `file` in the standard, DinD, and Coolify runtimes and require it in image verification. Advance the three Node pins to 26.11.1 to pass the live freshness gate.
- Archive all three available incident logs, related discussions/attachment, checksums, primary-source research, and before/after regression evidence in [the case study](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/tree/issue-2687-cdf77e59ffa9/docs/case-studies/issue-2687). The timeline distinguishes the earlier OOM event and explicitly identifies unavailable Agent logs.
- Prepare the patch release with a Changeset.

Reproduce without a live provider:

```bash
node tests/claude-result-error-precedence-2687.test.mjs
```

The initial replay failed 7 of 10 tests. The final regression has 18 passing tests covering framing, reset time/timezone, cost, diagnostic precedence, stale transient flags, real temporary-429 recovery, ENOSPC, native exit status, failed verification, missing-CLI guidance, and background-turn handling. `bash experiments/issue-2687/check-file.sh` verifies the attachment prerequisite.

Passed locally: all 576 default test files, including the 18-test regression and existing failed-verification, background-turn, usage-limit, and runtime-pin suites; ESLint; Prettier; duplication; secret scan; syntax and line limits; documentation checks; Changeset validation; authenticated dependency freshness (168/168 current).

All three CI workflows on implementation head `6ad714ae` passed: [Checks and release](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/actions/runs/37717540140), [Security](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/actions/runs/37717539904), and [Broken Link Checker](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/actions/runs/37717539905). The default and GitHub integration suites passed. Both Docker images built and completed container verification, including `file`, Node.js 26.11.1, live MCP registration, and nested Docker. The first DinD probe was killed with exit 137; rerunning the failed jobs on the same SHA passed without a source change. Complete logs for both attempts and local checks are preserved in the [validation record](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/issue-2687-cdf77e59ffa9/docs/case-studies/issue-2687/validation.md). The final commits only archive validation evidence.

Final documentation head `3aac9676` also passed [Checks and release](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/actions/runs/37721420240), [Security](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/actions/runs/37721419958), and [Broken Link Checker](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/actions/runs/37721419970). The working tree is clean and the latest `main` is included.

Upstream: [Box #129](https://github.com/link-foundation/box/issues/129) includes the finite reproduction, verified Homebrew workaround, and proposed shared dependency/image check. Claude's subtype/error combination matches the official SDK contract, so its interpretation is corrected here.
title: fix(claude): preserve terminal errors after failed tool commands
